items.stem: Which of the following best describes the position of the Moon on a full Moon day relative to the Sun?
If a person observes the Moon at sunrise on a day after a full Moon, what will they likely see?
Based on the passage, which of the following is true about the Moon's visibility?
What is the term used to describe the period when the bright portion of the Moon increases?
If the Moon is not visible for a few days, what could be the reason?
Why does the illuminated portion of the Moon seen from the Earth decrease when it appears closer to the Sun?

Why does the Moon appear in different positions in the sky each day?
If the Moon takes 50 minutes longer to return to the same position in the sky, what would be the approximate time between two consecutive full moons?
Based on the information in the passage, which of the following is true about the relationship between the Earth's rotation and the solar day?
According to the passage, what is the basis for defining a month?
The passage explains that the Gregorian calendar is based on the tropical year, which is the time between successive spring equinoxes. Why is the tropical year used instead of the sidereal year?
The passage mentions that the Earth takes slightly less time than 365 and a quarter days to complete one revolution around the Sun. What is the term used to describe this period?
Which of the following is a type of calendar that uses the Moon's phases for counting days and months but also makes adjustments to stay in sync with the solar year?
According to the passage, what is the name of the extra month added to some calendars to keep the lunar and solar years in sync?
Which of the following statements is true about the Indian National Calendar?
If a festival occurs on the same date every year in the Gregorian calendar, what can be inferred about its origin?
Which of the following best explains why the dates of festivals based on the sidereal calendar slowly shift in the tropical calendar?
Which of the following is a festival that is celebrated based on the phases of the Moon?
Based on the passage, which of the following statements is correct about the relationship between the Moon's position and the tides?
According to the passage, which of the following statements is true about the Moon's crescent?
If Vaishali saw the Moon from sunset to sunrise, which phase of the Moon would she have observed?
According to the passage, which of the following is the basis of the month in the Indian calendar?

The passage mentions that the dates of festivals based on the sidereal calendar slowly shift over time. What is the main reason for this shift?
Which of the following is a correct statement about artificial satellites?
Which of the following statements correctly describes the phases of the Moon?
Which of the following is a reason for having an extra month in luni-solar calendars?
A student observes that the Sun rises in the East and sets in the West on equinoxes. Which of the following best explains this phenomenon?
The passage mentions that the Indian National Calendar is a solar calendar and begins on 22 March. Which of the following best explains why this date is chosen?

The passage states that the Taittirīya Saṁhitā records the movement of the Sun as going northwards for six months and southwards for six months. Which of the following best explains how this observation is linked to the changing seasons?
What is the average time the Sun takes to go from its highest position in the sky on one day to the highest position in the sky the next day?
Why does the Moon appear to change shape from day to day?
Based on the passage, what is the reason for the difference between the lunar year and the solar year?
What is the main reason the Moon does not emit its own light?
What causes the change in the shape of the Moon as seen from Earth?
A student observes the Moon from Earth and notices that only a part of it is illuminated. What is the reason for this observation?
If a person sees a crescent Moon rising in the East when the Sun is setting, which of the following is most likely to be true?
